purpose: Recipient grounding contract for the Playthings presentation experiment. All mappings below are presentation-only unless Tiinex source material independently resolves the underlying semantic fact.

artDirection.root: ancient natural Root Tree with a real door; subtle human-made lamps/signage may exist around it but the tree is not a machine

visualCategories.plaything: actor; never a schema or artifact
visualCategories.artifact: normal artifact noun/object or short-lived interaction scene
visualCategories.schemaArtifact: .schema.md blueprint/document; never a living Plaything and never inherits the place semantics of the schema it describes

lifecycle.universalArtifactRule: artifact-derived visuals are Born from nothingness and normally Expire to nothingness
lifecycle.expiredDefault: remove from rendered world after the expire sequence; do not leave decayed remnants unless a later explicit presentation rule has a grounded reason
lifecycle.workspaceRule: workspace/place presentation is built by a Plaything; it does not spawn as a completed building
lifecycle.constructionRule: show the responsible Plaything travel to a legitimate destination, work, and visibly assemble the workspace/place from observed state

playthingLocomotion.frameIntent: 64x64 normalized runtime frames, 8 frames per row

playthingVerbs.frameIntent: 64x64 normalized runtime frames, 8 frames per row

placeModel.overworld: Shared Earth is one active scene, not one island per workspace.
placeModel.sceneStack: Entering a Place may fade the overworld and swap the same renderer to that Place interior. Child Places may become floors/rooms/departments and each floor or room may be a separate scene/loading zone.
placeModel.follow: If Follow is active and the followed Plaything enters a door/stairs/child Place, preserve actor identity, fade/swap scenes, and continue following inside.
placeModel.lookInside: A quick inspection may instead open a dialog containing its own Playthings canvas without changing the active world scene.
placeModel.doorGrammar: walk to entrance socket -> open door interaction -> enter -> fade -> scene swap -> continue

generativeCapacity.rule: assets describe building blocks and capacity, not pre-furnished static content
examples: 30 sleeping Playthings -> generate capacity for 30 beds
3 sleeping Playthings -> generate capacity for 3 beds
0 sleeping Playthings -> no decorative beds solely to make the room look furnished
17 stored schemas -> generate enough schema storage representation for 17 stored schemas
workspace presence/activity -> generate only justified workstations/machines/modules
generativeCapacity.interiorScale: interior scene dimensions may exceed exterior sprite footprint; this is presentation space, not claimed Tiinex geometry

schemaStorage.idea: A discovered schema may receive a presentation journey in which a Plaything studies/carries it to a Library/Archive Place, after which Look Inside can reveal stored schemas.
schemaStorage.boundary: The library journey/storage is presentation-only unless Tiinex material independently resolves an actual relation/place association. Do not invent Parent or Relation edges.

journeyReasonResolver.principle: Playthings travel to Places only for a reason grounded in observed lineage/material; never move actors to random places because it would look good.
candidatePriority: explicit resolved Place/context from loaded material
Place ancestor/descendant context already present in lineage
legitimate Workspace or Organization place presentation associated with the observed event
resting actor returns to its already-assigned habitat
schema storage journey to an already-legitimate Library/Archive only as explicit presentation
no spatial cause -> neutral Root Tree origin or neutral generated scene position, without claiming semantic place
journeyReasonResolver.ambiguous: When multiple legitimate candidates remain, presentation may deterministically choose among those candidates (e.g. road cost/nearest), but must not claim Tiinex selected that place.

roads.routing: grass costs more than established roads; roads may be preferred when they genuinely reduce presentation travel cost
roads.rootTree: roads meet a clearing/apron/entrance socket and must never render across the tree trunk/door core footprint
roads.boundary: roads are reconstructed presentation only, never Tiinex semantic route truth

rootTree.purpose: neutral fallback origin for living roots without an already-observed spatial origin
rootTree.appearance: large ancient natural tree with a door
rootTree.traffic: door is the common origin but a surrounding clearing should offer deterministic exit sockets so all roads do not form a one-pixel starburst
rootTree.authority: presentation-only; not Parent, Place, Relation, Organization, Workspace or semantic authority

fullscreen.goal: return Playthings to a proper fullscreen world; Viewer/header chrome should float over the world rather than consume inline layout space

knownHumanFrontier: make fork/sibling three-way choreography visibly readable
make roads organic rather than radial/graph-like
integrate real sprite atlases instead of placeholder SVG/pixel blocks
build scene-stack interiors and Follow across scene changes
implement Journey Reason Resolver before new Place travel rules
ensure all born/expire transitions animate rather than blink
preserve Viewer performance and worker-backed Playthings entry
